description: IAM Identity Center account assignment grants administrator-level permission-set policy
rationale: A named user or group is assigned a permission set containing AWS AdministratorAccess or an explicit inline Allow Action '*'. The finding is a privileged-access candidate; it does not simulate permission boundaries, SCPs, session policies or IAM deny evaluation.
remediation: Review the named principal, email, instance, permission set and target account. Replace administrator rights with task-specific permissions where feasible; verify effective controls and approval evidence.
